void kernel_gemm(double alpha, double beta, double C[20][25], double A[20][30], double B[30][25]) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 25; j++) {

            C[i][j] = alpha * sum + beta * C[i][j];
        }
    }
}
